positions.name: GreenhouseHumiditySensorDeploymentAndTelemetry
positions.frame: how should greenhouse humidity sensor rollout sequencing and telemetry reporting intervals be configured to protect vulnerable seedlings from seasonal frost damage?
positions.why: The segments cohere around setting operational constraints for greenhouse climate monitoring: establishing a hard seasonal installation deadline across all bays, prioritizing rollout to high-risk zones based on historical loss, ratifying the plan, and specifying minimum telemetry frequency to capture critical overnight drops.
